conceptBreakdown.heading: 6.1 Gibbs Free Energy & Spontaneity Criteria
conceptBreakdown.title: 6.1 Gibbs Free Energy & Spontaneity Criteria

summaryBox.title: Gibbs Free Energy
summaryBox.takeaway: ΔG_sys = ΔH - TΔS = -T ΔS_total. ΔG < 0 (Spontaneous), ΔG = 0 (Equilibrium), ΔG > 0 (Non-spontaneous).

conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Thermodynamic Link to Total Entropy**:
$$\Delta S_{\text{surr}} = -\frac{\Delta H_{\text{sys}}}{T} \implies \Delta S_{\text{total}} = \Delta S_{\text{sys}} - \frac{\Delta H_{\text{sys}}}{T} \implies \mathbf{-T \Delta S_{\text{total}} = \Delta G_{\text{sys}}}$$

• **Spontaneity Criteria at Constant $T, P$**:
- $\mathbf{\Delta G_{\text{sys}} < 0}$: Spontaneous / Exergonic Process ($\Delta S_{\text{total}} > 0$)
- $\mathbf{\Delta G_{\text{sys}} = 0}$: System at Thermodynamic Equilibrium ($\Delta S_{\text{total}} = 0$)
- $\mathbf{\Delta G_{\text{sys}} > 0}$: Non-Spontaneous / Endergonic Process ($\Delta S_{\text{total}} < 0$)

conceptBreakdown.heading: 6.2 Temperature Dependence & Equilibrium Constant (K_eq)
conceptBreakdown.title: 6.2 Temperature Dependence & Equilibrium Constant (K_eq)
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
SPONTANEITY CRITERIA AT CONSTANT T, P
   ΔH < 0, ΔS > 0 ──► Spontaneous at ALL temperatures
   ΔH > 0, ΔS < 0 ──► Non-Spontaneous at ALL temperatures
   ΔH < 0, ΔS < 0 ──► Spontaneous at LOW temperatures (T < ΔH/ΔS)
   ΔH > 0, ΔS > 0 ──► Spontaneous at HIGH temperatures (T > ΔH/ΔS)
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Chemical Equilibrium Coupling**:
$$\Delta_r G = \Delta_r G^\circ + RT \ln Q$$
At chemical equilibrium, $\Delta_r G = 0$ and $Q = K_{\text{eq}}$:
$$\mathbf{\Delta_r G^\circ = -RT \ln K_{\text{eq}} = -2.303 RT \log_{10} K_{\text{eq}}}$$
$$\mathbf{K_{\text{eq}} = e^{-\Delta_r G^\circ / RT}}$$

quickRevision: ΔH < 0 and ΔS > 0 is spontaneous at all temperatures.
ΔH > 0 and ΔS > 0 becomes spontaneous at high T (T > ΔH/ΔS).
